ayahs.translation: I do not worship those that you worship

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَاۤ اَنْتُمْ عٰبِدُوْنَ مَاۤ اَعْبُدُۚ
ayahs.translation: neither do you worship Him Whom I worship;

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَاۤ اَنَا عَابِدٌ مَّا عَبَدْتُّمْۙ
ayahs.translation: nor will I worship those whom you have worshipped;

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَاۤ اَنْتُمْ عٰبِدُوْنَ مَاۤ اَعْبُدُؕ
ayahs.translation: nor are you going to worship Him Whom I worship.
To you is your religion, and to me, my religion.
